landmark: Monday; previous 7 days exposure; no start during those 7 days
eligibility: official-ID linked current API cohort; past actual start 8-180 days ago; medical observation 8-365 days before landmark
episode_semantics: same horse and lexical family; onset after >gap days without that family; no clinical episode certification
exposures: new onset in previous 7 days and continuing observation in previous 7 days, mutually exclusive by family
ability_controls: horse fixed effect, last pre-index result and previous 5 results, prior time relative to race, rating, age, starts, prior gaps and grade
main_does_not_control: outcomes of first/second return when modeling later returns
support: at least 30 new-onset landmark rows, 20 exposed horses, and 20 horses with both exposure and non-exposure observations in each model
multiple_testing: BH across all family-onset by endpoint tests in primary pooled period; annual and sensitivity families separately
post_estimation_additional_sensitivity: BH separately for return-gap, conditional-performance, and joint nonreturn/nonpodium domains; added to assess whether numerous gap signals drive conditional-performance significance
clustering: horse and landmark date, plus outcome race for performance; conservative maximum of one-way and two-way variances
